title: Amazon is winding down most of its Nova AI models to bet on one frontier model
excerpt: Amazon is winding down most of its flagship Nova AI models. It is betting what remains on a single, bigger effort to build one genuinely competitive foundation model. The move gives shape to a retreat that until now looked mostly like close
content_html:
Amazon is winding down most of its flagship Nova AI models. It is betting what remains on a single, bigger effort to build one genuinely competitive foundation model. The move gives shape to a retreat that until now looked mostly like closed offices and job cuts.

The company has begun deprecating most of its in-house Nova line, Business Insider first reported. That includes the high-end Premier and Omni models, the Reel video generator and the Canvas image generator. Some staff call this “KTLO” mode, short for “keep the lights on.” The models stay supported for existing customers, but are no longer a development priority.

This is the concrete update to a story we first covered months ago. Amazon shut its AGI Lab and quit a race it never led. Back then, the news was a closed lab and layoffs. Now it is clear which products are being sacrificed, and what they are being sacrificed for.

One big bet instead of many

Resources are shifting to a new effort called Frontier Model Research, or FMR, led by Pieter Abbeel. He joined Amazon through its 2024 acquisition of the robotics startup Covariant. A new flagship model is expected to debut at Amazon’s re:Invent conference this autumn, Reuters reported. It could still carry the Nova name.

The logic is focus. Under previous AI chief Rohit Prasad, Amazon spread itself across text, image and video models. Peter DeSantis, who took over the consolidated group in December, has concentrated talent and scarce compute on fewer frontier bets. Prasad left at the end of 2025, and AGI Lab founder David Luan departed in February.

Nova is not vanishing. Amazon says several products will stay. It is keeping Nova 2 Lite, Nova 2 Sonic, the Nova Forge customisation service and the Nova Act agent tool. The company’s San Francisco AGI site, an 80-person research group, has closed, GeekWire reported.

Where Amazon actually wins

Amazon never made Nova a household name the way OpenAI, Anthropic and Google did with their models. Its systems also proved expensive to run for the value they returned. Cheaper rivals piled on the pressure, part of a wider shift to cut-price models.

So Amazon leaned into what it does best: infrastructure. AWS is the landlord for much of the industry, with compute commitments worth $138bn from OpenAI and more than $100bn from Anthropic. Its custom Trainium chips are now a multibillion-dollar business that Jeff Bezos calls a fourth company pillar.

An Amazon spokesperson rejected the idea of a retreat. “AI models remain one of the most important things we’re working on, and that hasn’t changed,” the spokesperson said, adding that the company “continually evolve[s]” its lineup around what customers need.

The harder question is the one Nova never answered. Amazon can host everyone else’s models and sell the chips underneath them. Whether it can also build a frontier model that developers actively choose over Claude, Gemini or GPT is what re:Invent will test.

content_html_zh:
亚马逊正在逐步淘汰其大部分旗舰 Nova AI 型号。 它把剩下的赌注押在单一的、更大的努力上，以建立一个真正有竞争力的基础模型。 此举形成了一种撤退的形式，到目前为止，撤退看起来主要是关闭办公室和裁员。

据 Business Insider 最先报道，该公司已开始弃用其大部分内部 Nova 产品线。 其中包括高端 Premier 和 Omni 型号、Reel 视频生成器和 Canvas 图像生成器。 一些工作人员将此称为“KTLO”模式，是“保持灯亮着”的缩写。 这些模型仍受现有客户支持，但不再是开发优先事项。

这是我们几个月前首次报道的故事的具体更新。 亚马逊关闭了其 AGI 实验室，并退出了一场它从未领先的竞赛。 当时的新闻是实验室关闭和裁员。 现在很清楚哪些产品正在被牺牲，以及它们被牺牲的目的是什么。

一大笔赌注而不是很多赌注

资源正在转移到由 Pieter Abbeel 领导的一项名为前沿模型研究 (FMR) 的新项目上。 他通过 2024 年收购机器人初创公司 Covariant 加入亚马逊。 据路透社报道，一款新的旗舰机型预计将在今年秋季的亚马逊 re:Invent 大会上首次亮相。 它仍然可以带有 Nova 的名字。

逻辑是焦点。 在前人工智能首席执行官罗希特·普拉萨德 (Rohit Prasad) 的领导下，亚马逊将业务扩展到文本、图像和视频模型。 Peter DeSantis 在 12 月接管了合并后的集团，他将人才和稀缺的计算集中在较少的前沿投资上。 Prasad 于 2025 年底离职，AGI Lab 创始人 David Luan 于 2 月份离职。

新星并没有消失。 亚马逊表示，有几种产品将保留。 它保留了 Nova 2 Lite、Nova 2 Sonic、Nova Forge 定制服务和 Nova Act 代理工具。 据 GeekWire 报道，该公司位于旧金山的 AGI 站点（一个由 80 人组成的研究小组）已经关闭。

亚马逊真正获胜的地方

亚马逊从未像 OpenAI、Anthropic 和谷歌对其模型所做的那样，让 Nova 成为家喻户晓的名字。 事实证明，就其返回的价值而言，其系统的运行成本也很高。 更便宜的竞争对手不断施加压力，这是向降价车型更广泛转变的一部分。

因此，亚马逊专注于它最擅长的领域：基础设施。 AWS 是该行业大部分领域的所有者，OpenAI 的计算承诺价值达 1,380 亿美元，Anthropic 的计算承诺价值超过 1000 亿美元。 其定制的 Trainium 芯片现在是一项价值数十亿美元的业务，杰夫·贝索斯 (Jeff Bezos) 称之为公司的第四支柱。

亚马逊发言人拒绝了撤退的想法。 该发言人表示：“人工智能模型仍然是我们正在研究的最重要的事情之一，这一点没有改变。”他补充说，该公司围绕客户的需求“不断发展”其产品阵容。

更难的问题是诺瓦从未回答过的。 亚马逊可以托管其他人的模型并销售其底层的芯片。 是否也能构建出一个让开发者主动选择的前沿模型，而不是Claude、Gemini或GPT，是re:Invent将要测试的。
